## Eight guided laboratories

Each lab translates its matching chapter into calculations, data work, R practice, interpretation, and reproducible communication.

::: {.statx-directory}
<a class="statx-directory-card" href="lab-01/"><span>LAB 01 · AVAILABLE</span><h3>Mathematics for Data Analysis</h3><p>Practice percentages, algebra, functions, graphs, and probability by hand and with R.</p><b>START LAB →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="lab-02/"><span>LAB 02</span><h3>Describe a Dataset</h3><p>Classify variables, summarize distributions, and construct informative visualizations.</p><b>OPEN LAB →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="lab-03/"><span>LAB 03</span><h3>Simulate Probability</h3><p>Use simulation to investigate rules, conditional probability, and common distributions.</p><b>OPEN LAB →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="lab-04/"><span>LAB 04</span><h3>Reason from Samples</h3><p>Explore sampling distributions, confidence intervals, tests, errors, and power.</p><b>OPEN LAB →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="lab-05/"><span>LAB 05</span><h3>Compare Groups</h3><p>Match research designs to t-tests, ANOVA, chi-square tests, and interpretation.</p><b>OPEN LAB →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="lab-06/"><span>LAB 06</span><h3>Build and Diagnose Models</h3><p>Fit regression models, interpret coefficients, inspect assumptions, and validate predictions.</p><b>OPEN LAB →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="lab-07/"><span>LAB 07</span><h3>Resample and Adapt</h3><p>Apply nonparametric, bootstrap, cross-validation, missing-data, and time-series tools.</p><b>OPEN LAB →</b></a>

<a class="statx-directory-card" href="lab-08/"><span>LAB 08 · OPTIONAL</span><h3>Likelihood and Estimation</h3><p>Connect likelihood, MLE, MAP, bias–variance, and asymptotic behavior.</p><b>OPEN LAB →</b></a>
:::
